copy.headline: AT&T Stadium lights up kettle red
copy.caption: The Dallas Cowboys and The Salvation Army mark a major milestone in their 30-year partnership Monday with a first-of-its-kind lighting ceremony at AT&T Stadium.

story.title: AT&T Stadium lights up kettle red
story.summary: The Dallas Cowboys and The Salvation Army mark a major milestone in their 30-year partnership Monday with a first-of-its-kind lighting ceremony at AT&T Stadium, kicking off Thanksgiving week and celebrating the annual Red Kettle Campaign.
